description: This file contains the implementation of the 'Category' class within the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It handles the display logic for product categories, including loading category information, generating breadcrumb navigation, processing filtering and sorting options, and retrieving product data for display on category pages.

classes.name: Category
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling product category pages, including loading category details, products within the category, and managing display data such as images, pricing, and breadcrumbs.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to handle the display of a category page, including loading language, category info, breadcrumbs, products, and setting up the view data.
